request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Quantized checkpoints are provided (Scout as BF16 weights, on-the-fly int4 quantization code provided); technical info and recipes for using Llama 4 in applications are in the llama-cookbook repo (https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-cookbook); system-level protections (Llama Guard, Prompt Guard, Code Shield) are available, with reference implementation at https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-agentic-system; Purple Llama GitHub repo for trust tools.
quotes: We've provided quantized checkpoints for deployment flexibility, but all reported evaluations and testing were conducted on bf16 models.
We provide code for on-the-fly int4 quantization which minimizes performance degradation as well.
For more technical information about generation parameters and recipes for how to use Llama 4 in applications, please go here (https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-cookbook).

We provide the community with system level protections (https://llama.meta.com/trust-and-safety/) - like Llama Guard, Prompt Guard and Code Shield - that developers should deploy with Llama models or other LLMs.
Our Trust tools are open sourced for the community to use and widely distributed across ecosystem partners including cloud service providers.
